thread:
sam: quick usability question: bulk-rotate modal for creds  should we require a typed confirm when rotating >3 keys?
lucy: +1 for typed confirm at >5. under 5 feels like friction. also need a preview table so people can verify selections.
omar: security prefers typed confirm for any mass action, but we can relax for API calls. UI-only enforcement ok.
leah: copy suggestion for the modal header: "Replace selected API keys". body: short explainer and a configurable grace window. show default 1 minute undo.
aria-bot: accessibility note: typed confirm must have a visible label, aria-describedby instructions, and not rely on color alone. ensure focus lands in the dialog and trap focus.
sam: export/download: after rotate we show the new tokens once; propose a one-minute CSV download link. aria-live announce: "Download available for 60 seconds."
lucy: implement short-lived S3 presigned link for CSV + make download available via keyboard. show clear warning: "This file contains secrets. Store securely."
omar: backend will support 60s default TTL and org override up to 10m. will log rotate events with `bulk.rotate` and `exported_csv` prop.
sam: agree to A/B test typed-confirm threshold (3 vs 5) and default view (list vs grid). i'll update prototypes and tag teams. thanks! :sparkles:
